# Read-only sequence display evidence

These byte-identical files are from the user-supplied r6 review evidence ZIP
(2026-10-06), not newly executed biological calculations.

- `source.fasta`: `source_only_inputs/actual.fasta`, SHA-256
  `fc1f91bdec45e4be79df7885e9ea3bb3caf7bb14a5094ba5cad323585c5f7cb2`.
- `parent_result.json`: `generic_sequence_parent_result.json`, SHA-256
  `327517dff153fef04fc94a498985869c22f80e5f9115c85dbbe17ea8799cfc77`.

The source-derived FASTA contains 12 records. The JSON contains already recorded
sequence statistics. Tests parse identities and render these existing values;
they do not invoke scientific handlers or recompute numerical features. This is
an incomplete source-derived dataset, not validated cloning/structure/LLPS data.
Original source provenance remains in the user's review evidence archive.
